description:
Sparking Instinct reads supported menus, character selection, training, controls, battle gauges, and story screens. Buu420 made the audio descriptions for the main opening and post-tutorial movie.

Requires Windows x64 and Steam build 24953175 (game version 3022.021.003.012.015). The ZIP includes the native reader, narration, Reloaded II, and Prism. Amethyst setup reuses x64 .NET 9 Desktop Runtime 9.0.8 or a later .NET 9 patch. If needed, setup offers the Microsoft installer. Close the game before installing, updating, or uninstalling. Start the game from Steam or its desktop shortcut.

F6 reads the screen. F7 and F8 review items. F9 switches between reading all visible dialogue and skipping verified voiced lines. Text-only story dialogue still reads. Visible tutorial instructions repeat every 20 seconds.

defaultPreInstall.what: Verify the Steam build and check for a loader conflict and a compatible x64 .NET 9 Desktop Runtime.
defaultPreInstall.why: Sparking Instinct uses build-specific bindings and Reloaded II needs the .NET 9 Desktop Runtime.
defaultPreInstall.modifies: Reads the game folder and installed runtime versions. If the runtime is missing, downloads Microsoft's installer and asks for Windows administrator approval. Amethyst copies the mod files after setup.
